definitions.risk: 0.8 mean(event mean_point_error)+0.2 mean largest max(1,ceil(.1n)) event errors; training J=10*risk, not RMSE
definitions.primary_actual15: genuine available interval at most15s after causal100ms initialization; unchanged original classification and complete denominators
definitions.up_to8: separate original genuine interval at most8s; never renamed as15s
definitions.confirmation: original physical LOS with first continuous5-sample confirmation window endpoint; 10 history rows concatenated; time=.01*(k-10); latency/untriggered/unresolved are NA
definitions.timing_common_T: same truth/A/B/C/R_N detectable numerically qualified events; empty set cannot pass; E average absolute confirmation error, u=max fine/coarse confirmation difference
definitions.same_precision_cost: CPU float64 single-thread; initialization and paired history/future RK4, output/metrics included; not pure8s deployment
definitions.comparison: common96 is primary; unequal terminal updates cannot isolate structure
definitions.mechanism: same C predicted state and C parameters, C-Btrace and C-A force-rate difference /rstar per-second; gate activation only, no true-mechanism identification
